acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any claim that the task requires lived causal learning rather than target/state/signature leakage, or that an external-development result is available.

acceptance_tests.expected: Witnessed atoms, relations, exceptions, and one legal shortcut can be written and read; invalid, stale, unsupported, cyclic, or complete-solution records are rejected.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The claimed memory contract if the system cannot distinguish admissible local experiential structure from unsupported or answer-bearing material.
acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise every lifecycle transition, evidence-equivalence case, valid diamond, forbidden cycle, and corpus eligibility class.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Read-only common-deck manifests, state hashes before/after evaluation, scorer write-denial logs, and reset receipts.
acceptance_tests.expected: All common-deck arms see identical public streams and frozen reader budgets; evaluation leaves source-life bytes unchanged and sealed outcomes cannot enter cognition.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Fixed-deck attribution if evaluation or arm-specific experience changes the life state.
acceptance_tests.setup: Run every arm on the same ordered stream, then adversarially attempt evaluator/scorer writes and verify byte-identical source-life hashes.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Per-arm corpus hashes, reader receipts, resource ledger, calibration result table, and mandatory-arm failure report.
acceptance_tests.expected: Mandatory P0/P1/P2/P3C/P4/P5T/P5L/P6 implementations are present, matched where comparison requires matching, and report any failed cell rather than omitting it.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A comparative compiler or substrate conclusion if corpus, reader, thinker, budget, or baseline implementation differs without separate labeling.
acceptance_tests.setup: Use the fixed common deck at frozen checkpoints; compare the declared mandatory arms and preserve active/retained bytes, compute, and token ledgers.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Capability-family fixtures, shortcut collision audit, action traces, revision traces, and per-family scores.
acceptance_tests.expected: A0 is diagnostic only; A1-A4 meet their construction definitions, no shortcut ends an A3/A4 goal, and exception evidence can cause a supported revision and recovery.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A constructive action claim if gains reduce to witnessed lookup, a stored final plan, or unrevised false memory.
acceptance_tests.setup: Evaluate frozen A0-A4 decks with four-to-six-action A3/A4 goals, paired twins, and controlled exception/rule-change cases.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Seeded-prefix replay hashes, clone manifests, randomized memory-assignment ledger, sealed branch-outcome store, and paired estimand report.
acceptance_tests.expected: Valid clones begin from the same canonical state, receive only assigned memory, preserve action budgets, and never return branch outcomes to the source life.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The on-policy flywheel claim if clone semantics are invalid, memory assignment is not causal, or branch outcomes contaminate training.
acceptance_tests.setup: Replay a public prefix, reject hash-mismatched clones, randomize memory at the branch boundary, and evaluate independent sealed decks afterward.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Independent-review report over frozen code, manifests, prompts, models, budgets, inputs, outputs, and claim boundary; separate author-side advocate response.
acceptance_tests.expected: A fresh reviewer finds no unresolved leakage, attribution, protocol, or artifact-binding defect; any repaired defect receives a new bound review.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Eligibility for a GPU science run or scientific promotion when independent review rejects the exact frozen evidence.

loops.after: For each ordinary episode: current public state plus bounded reader results -> wake chooses exactly one cognitive/action operation -> environment returns ordinary public outcome -> immutable event/status append -> released/deferred branch handling. Wake stops on release, supported action, irreducible missing dependency, budget exhaustion, malformed output, or defer.
loops.before: Within-episode thinking/action loop had no fully bound branch and fail-closed transition contract.
loops.rationale: Models lived action/outcome experience and narrow planning as distinct from sleep consolidation.
loops.stop_condition: Released action obtains an ordinary outcome; otherwise explicit terminal/deferred state or hard visible budget.
loops.trigger: A public goal/state or a resumed active branch.

loops.after: At fixed geometric checkpoints, sleep reads only the new ordinary event block, released paths, eligible prior semantic records, and typed selection-only agendas; dream proposes local candidates; chronology/status machinery validates them; compiler emits supported multi-view corpus; psi_l is cumulatively rebuilt from theta_0. Recur at each checkpoint.
loops.before: Experience, dream, compiler, and LoRA updates were conceptually connected but eligibility, recurrence, and transport were not fully bound.
loops.rationale: Preserves human's sleep-as-compiler idea while making local semantic growth, re-expression, and parametric transport separately falsifiable.
loops.stop_condition: Checkpoint corpus is sealed and adapter/optimizer manifest is complete; malformed or ineligible material is retained only as negative/audit data.
loops.trigger: Geometric lifetime checkpoint after ordinary public outcomes, not evaluator feedback.

loops.after: A later wake resolver receives only bounded local MemoryRead records from its assigned backend and reconstructs a goal-conditioned explicit working path; outcome feedback can create later released traces/agendas and therefore influence a future sleep checkpoint.
loops.before: The decompression/reconstruction distinction and later feedback path were insufficiently bound.
loops.rationale: Makes memory a source of intermediary associations, while the complete organism performs composition, planning, revision, and action.
loops.stop_condition: Wake reaches a supported release, defers, or exhausts its visible operation/query budget.
loops.trigger: A later goal after a checkpoint mounts its assigned memory backend.

loops.after: At each fixed checkpoint, freeze source-life writes/caches, mount assigned checkpoint memory, run a fresh read-only held-out deck, seal outcomes, and score only offline. No evaluation artifact recurs into life state.
loops.before: Fixed-deck evaluation was not fully enforced as a non-recurrent isolation loop.
loops.rationale: Identifies representation/use without crediting a memory arm for different experience collection.
loops.stop_condition: Deck completes or action cap is reached; source-life pre/post hashes must be identical.
loops.trigger: A sealed checkpoint under the common ordered public stream.

loops.after: Replay a canonical public prefix to isolated hash-checked clones, randomly assign allowed memory intervention, allow matched remaining action budget, seal clone outcomes, then evaluate all arms on an independent read-only deck. Repeat over paired worlds; never write clone outcomes to source life.
loops.before: On-policy experience/representation swaps were described without valid recurrence and sealing semantics.
loops.rationale: Tests later feedback from memory-informed thinking/action into future evidence separately from the fixed-deck claim.
loops.stop_condition: Clone hash mismatch, impossible continuation, or matched remaining action budget exhausted; all resulting branch outcomes remain sealed.
loops.trigger: A paired-world checkpoint with a valid public action-prefix replay.

loops.after: Across distinct lives, reset every per-life cognitive store, adapter, optimizer, cache, RNG, process handle, prompt history, and temporary path; inject prior-life canaries and require NOT_FOUND plus clean-base adapter hash before admitting the new life.
loops.before: Per-life reset was incomplete and did not bind process/global artifacts.
loops.rationale: Ensures lifetime learning is per-life psi_l, while a future shared LOOP adapter remains outside this unimplemented pilot.
loops.stop_condition: All canaries return NOT_FOUND and reset receipts validate; otherwise fail closed and quarantine the run.
loops.trigger: Before every new world-life or resume from a sealed predecessor.

summary: This proposal turns the developmental idea into a bounded pilot: ordinary action/outcome episodes create immutable evidence; recurrent sleep proposes and validates only local semantic growth; a compiler re-expresses supported content into a per-life LoRA; later goal-conditioned retrieval plus explicit waking reconstruction supports action; and fixed-deck and isolated on-policy loops separately test memory use and feedback. It intentionally does not claim a learned thinker, learned dreamer, human development, general intelligence, or LoRA-based discovery.
system_thesis: The complete temporal organism—not a LoRA alone—may progressively convert its own ordinary action/outcome history into an auditable, connected experiential approximation. Dream-time local connection growth and re-expression create supported semantic material; per-life LoRA carries lossy associations across context pressure; goal-conditioned waking retrieval and explicit multi-step reconstruction turn those associations into planning, revision, and action; and later action outcomes can supply evidence for subsequent dream cycles. The proposed pilot tests a bounded behavioral version of this thesis with frozen base and controller, not autonomous discovery or a learned general intelligence.
title: Developmental experiential learning v2: bound recurrent sleep-compiler and per-life memory protocol
